documents.title: COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATE FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30Th, 2026.
COMPLIANCE CERTIFICATE FOR THE QUARTER ENDED SEPTEMBER 30Th, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation

analysis.summary: Modis Navnirman Limited reported its Q1 FY27 financial results, noting a year-on-year revenue increase of 27.92% to INR58.26 crores and a PAT growth of 25.81% to INR8.54 crores. Management highlighted steady execution across its six ongoing projects and an asset-light redevelopment model focused on Mumbai's western and expanded suburbs. The company noted that demand in the Mumbai real estate market remains robust despite rising supply, and management expressed confidence in the company's growth roadmap for FY27. Modis Navnirman Limited reported its financial and operational performance for Q1 FY27, highlighting revenue of Rs 58.26 crore, EBITDA of Rs 11.65 crore, and PAT of Rs 8.54 crore. Management noted steady construction progress across ongoing projects such as Rashmi Square, Rashmi Signature, Rashmi Delight, Rashmi Manorath, Rashmi Icon, and Rashmi Avenue, alongside securing a new redevelopment project.

capex_expansion.claim: The company's current portfolio consists of six ongoing projects, 14 completed projects, and five upcoming projects.
capex_expansion.quote: Together with this, currently we have six ongoing projects and 14 completed projects, and five upcoming projects across Bombay and its region, taking our portfolio to 25 premium residential projects.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully secured another new redevelopment project during the quarter.
capex_expansion.quote: The quarter marked another important milestone for the Company with the successful securing of another new redevelopment project.

capex_expansion.claim: Upcoming projects include Rashmi Shetal and Rashmi Gold which the company recently acquired.
capex_expansion.quote: Upcoming projects include Rashmi Shetal and Rashmi Gold which we have recently acquired.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects healthy margins of around 20% to 30% in every redevelopment project.
margins_costs.quote: But a healthy margins of around 20% to 30% should be expected in every project.

margins_costs.claim: Revenue from operations increased by 27.9% to 58.26 crore in Q1 FY27.
margins_costs.quote: “Modis Navnirman Limited delivered a strong performance in Q1 FY27, with revenue from operations increasing by 27.9% to %58.26 crore, while EBITDA grew by 14.2% to X11.65 crore and PAT rose by 25.8% to X8.54 crore, reflecting disciplined execution, operational efficiency, and the strength of the Company's redevelopment-led business model.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted that margins saw some moderation due to project mix, execution, and ongoing construction expenses associated with larger projects, but believe this is temporary.
margins_costs.quote: While margins saw some moderation due to project mix and execution and ongoing construction expenses associated with larger projects, we believe this is temporary and our long-term margin profile remains healthy.

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold around 44,000 square feet of area during the first quarter of FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: One number I want to specifically mention is the area sold, which in Q1 FY27, we have sold around 44,000 square feet.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that around 80% of the inventory in Rashmi Square has been nearly sold off.
orders_capacity.quote: See, Rashmi Square has been nearly sold off around 80%.

orders_capacity.claim: Management stated that Rashmi Signature has been nearly sold off by 50% to 65%.
orders_capacity.quote: Rashmi Signature has been nearly sold off 50%.

orders_capacity.claim: The total project portfolio consists of 7.5 lakh square feet, out of which 4.92 lakh square feet is booked and 2.40 lakh square feet is available inventory.
orders_capacity.quote: Our total project portfolio consists of 7.5 lakh square feet, out of which 4.92 is booked and 2.40 lakh available inventory.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that the Rashmi Govind Dalvi project is on hold due to a government stay in the 500-meter area.
risks_headwinds.quote: Rashmi Govind Dalvi project is a little on hold.

management_commitments.claim: Management expects Rashmi Square and Rashmi Signature to be handed over with an OC in the third quarter.
management_commitments.quote: In FY - in the third quarter, we'll be probably handing over with OC.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated a focus on accelerating project execution, selectively expanding the redevelopment portfolio, maintaining financial discipline, and delivering sustainable value.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead, we remain focused on accelerating project execution, selectively expanding our redevelopment portfolio, maintaining financial discipline, and delivering sustainable value for all stakeholders.

management_commitments.claim: Rashmi Square project will be delivered in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: We will be delivering that project in FY27. This year we'll be delivering Rashmi Square.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that margins will bounce back to previous levels.
management_commitments.quote: No, no, we'll bounce back to our previous levels.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
